definitions.explanation: A person who composes haiku poetry.

examples.japanese: {松尾|まつお}{芭蕉|ばしょう}は{有名|ゆうめい}な{俳人|はいじん}だ。
examples.english: Matsuo Basho is a famous haiku poet.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{現代|げんだい}の{俳人|はいじん}として{活躍|かつやく}している。
examples.english: She is active as a contemporary haiku poet.

examples.japanese: {多|おお}くの{俳人|はいじん}がこの{地|ち}を{訪|おとず}れた。
examples.english: Many haiku poets have visited this place.

notes:
{俳人|はいじん} refers to a person who composes {俳句|はいく} (haiku), the traditional 5-7-5 syllable form of Japanese poetry.

FORMS:
{俳|はい} (haiku-related) + {人|じん} (person). The same {人|じん} suffix appears in {歌人|かじん} (waka poet) and {詩人|しじん} (poet).

FAMOUS {俳人|はいじん}:
- {松尾|まつお}{芭蕉|ばしょう} (Matsuo Basho) — Edo period, most celebrated
- {与謝|よさ}{蕪村|ぶそん} (Yosa Buson) — Edo period, also a painter
- {小林|こばやし}{一茶|いっさ} (Kobayashi Issa) — Edo period, known for warmth
- {正岡|まさおか}{子規|しき} (Masaoka Shiki) — Meiji period, modernized haiku

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {歌人|かじん}: waka/tanka poet
- {詩人|しじん}: poet (general, includes Western-style poetry)
- {俳人|はいじん} is specific to haiku; for someone who writes other forms of poetry, use {詩人|しじん}
